introduction.text: Shardee is a simple video-making app that makes it easier to record everyday moments and turn them into something special. Record brief moments in clips of 0.5, 1 or 2 seconds, then automatically join them into one finished video. From recording to editing and rendering, Shardee lets you do it all in one app, so you never miss the special moments in everyday life.

notices: We recommend using videos recorded with Shardee when joining clips. If you join videos recorded with another camera, some videos may not import or errors may occur.
There is no limit on the duration or number of clips you can join. However, selecting very long videos or too many clips may cause the app to close unexpectedly.

items.question: Does Shardee cost money?
items.answer: • Downloading Shardee and using its basic features—recording short videos, joining clips and adding captions—is free.

items.question: What are the premium features?
items.answer:
• Premium features are available to users who purchase them.
    • Automatic zoom-in/out recording mode: Automatically zoom in or out while recording to create more dynamic videos.
    • Layout recording mode: Record in two-panel or three-panel layouts.
    • Dual mode: Record with the front and rear cameras at the same time.
    • Additional duration buttons: Get extra duration buttons that you can customize.

items.question: How can I record videos longer than 2 seconds?
items.answer: • The 0.5s and 1s buttons are fixed. Select 2s, then tap the button again to reveal a slider for adjusting the duration. You can choose any recording duration from 2s to 10s.

items.question: Where are videos recorded with Shardee saved?
items.answer: • They are saved directly to your phone's photo library. Shardee does not separately store or own the videos you record.

items.question: What happens if I delete a video from my device?
items.answer: • Videos recorded with Shardee are stored only on your device. If you delete a video from your device, the app cannot import or recover it.

items.question: How do I change the order of clips while editing?
items.answer: • To change the order, press and hold a clip, then drag it to the position you want.

items.question: Where are finished, rendered videos saved?
items.answer: • Videos you create with Shardee are also saved to your device.

items.question: Is there a limit on video length or the number of clips?
items.answer:
• There is no limit on video length or the number of clips, but excessively long videos or too many clips may cause the app to close unexpectedly.
  • When joining clips, we recommend keeping the final video between 30 and 60 seconds.

items.question: How can I save a draft?
items.answer:
• When you tap the X button in the upper-left corner to leave the editor, you can save the video you are working on.
  • If you close the app after joining clips, the video you were working on is saved separately as a draft.

items.question: How can I request a refund for a purchase?
items.answer:
• You can request a refund for an in-app purchase according to the policies of the store where you paid. Refund eligibility and processing depend on that store's policies. Follow the instructions below to request a refund from the relevant store.
  • You can usually check the status within 24–48 hours after submitting a request. If it is approved, additional time may be needed for the refund to appear on your payment method, depending on that payment method.
    • If you paid through the App Store

    Apple receives and reviews refund requests. Please follow these steps.

    • Sign in to reportaproblem.apple.com.
    • Under the problem selection, choose Request a refund.
    • Choose a reason, select the purchase you want refunded, and submit your request.
    • If you paid through Google Play

    Please follow these instructions to request a refund through Google Play.

    • Go to play.google.com and sign in to the Google account used for the purchase.
    • From your profile in the upper-right corner, go to Payments & subscriptions > Budget & order history.
    • Choose Report a problem for the order you want refunded.
    • Select a reason and submit your refund request.

items.question: I can't record a video.
items.answer: • Check your camera permission. If camera access is not allowed, enable it. You can check this under iPhone Settings → Shardee.

items.question: Sound isn't being recorded.
items.answer: • Check your microphone permission. If microphone access is not allowed, enable it. You can check this under iPhone Settings → Shardee.

items.question: My recorded videos stutter.
items.answer: • On some phones, recording in 4k or turning camera stabilization OFF can cause frame drops in recorded videos. Change the resolution to 1080k or turn camera stabilization ON.

items.question: Videos won't import from my gallery. You can check this under phone Settings → Shardee.
items.answer: • Check your gallery access permission. If access is not allowed, enable it. You can check this under iPhone Settings → Shardee.

items.question: Can I import photos from my gallery too?
items.answer: • You can now import photos along with videos. Photos taken as Live Photos or Motion Photos are automatically converted to videos when imported.

items.question: Videos made by joining clips are saved only in 1080p.
items.answer: • The clip-joining feature only supports 1080p output. Even if you import 4k videos, exporting saves the result in 1080p.

items.question: My video won't save.
items.answer: • Check your phone's storage space. If there is not enough space, videos may fail to record or save.

items.question: The video isn't exactly 1 second long.
items.answer:
• Depending on the shutter speed, videos are saved at around 1.2–1.4 seconds. The actual duration may vary with your duration setting as follows.
    • 0.5 seconds: 0.4–0.5 seconds
    • 1 second: 1–1.4 seconds
    • 2 seconds: 2–2.4 seconds
